name: Subic Bay Freeport Zone 32KM Challenge 2026
short_description: A multi-distance race in Subic Bay Freeport Zone, Philippines, held on August 16, 2026, featuring 32KM, 21.1KM, 10KM, and 5KM options.
ai_summary: The Subic Bay Freeport Zone 32KM Challenge 2026 is scheduled for August 16, 2026, taking place along the Boardwalk in Subic, within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone / Olongapo area in the Philippines. The event, organized by JCIR Events, offers multiple distance options including 32KM, 21.1KM, 10KM, and 5KM, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance.
pros: Multiple distance options (32KM, 21.1KM, 10KM, 5KM) suit a range of runner abilities

faqs.question: When is the Subic Bay Freeport Zone 32KM Challenge 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is set to take place on August 16, 2026. It will be held at the Boardwalk in Subic, located within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone / Olongapo area in the Philippines. This date applies to all distance categories offered as part of the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes this event?
